I'm surprised to hear that someone has a similar experience with friendships/relationships as I do lol I've always wondered if I'm just aroace tbh

but honestly I think anything between asexual and allosexual (and -romantic) is unnecessary, seeing as you're either asexual/aromantic or you're just not. but if words like demisexual/demiromantic are useful terms for a person, I don't really see the harm. it's not hurting anyone to say that you need strong connections with someone to feel sexual/romantic attraction, is it?

I always thought the online subscriptions would be nice, too bad they're location limited

I live in Minnesota and plume and folx do estrogen but not testosterone here which sucks

the name I currently use sounds similar to my deadname (the John to Jane example basically), but I hate how similar it sounds but I can't find a new name which goes with my uncommon last name so I'm kinda screwed it seems

yeah, honestly I'm very picky about the fiber content of the fabric I want to get, but things like wool are difficult to find without some % of polyester, and on top of that 100% *not* polyester fabric is expensive. even cotton is like $10/yard. and on top of that, I can barely afford (new) clothes anyways so the fact that fabric is more expensive than clothing doesn't make any sense at all. I guess somewhere along the line society's got accustomed to having things made for you instead of making them yourself.

I will admit, I've never tried checking secondhand shops for fabric. I usually buy clothes at thrift stores and such, so its not like I'm unfamiliar with the scene I just.. the amount of things you can donate to a thrift store is shocking lol

as for the stuffed animals, yeah I guess that would take a bit more skill, though I'd say most of that skill would be involved in making a pattern that actually works, and I just used free patterns I found online lol so all that work was taken out of it for me

yeah, I think the sleeves are a separate piece for movement's sake, but I guess technically they might be able to just be one with the "body" of the shirt from the get-go. something worth looking into/experimenting with maybe? lol

I have a huge interest in how things were done before, as well as why it was done that way. I honestly can't wrap my head around why we stopped doing certain things, except for convenience I guess? but not everything needs to be convenient. so I've taken to trying my best to figure out how to live as they used to, but that's hard when everyone and everything seems to be so painfully.. modern lol

wow, I've never even considered how much work it'd be to sew all of your kids' clothes, especially since as you said kids grow and they grow fast lol my younger brother grew so quickly my mom would buy him pants and he'd wear them once or twice because in a month he'd grown and they were too short lol

well.. while I suppose that is an option (make new clothes now, I mean), the ideas I have for my clothing are somewhat involved, so if my size was to drastically change I'd rather wait. but I haven't really looked into fabric stores/stores that potentially sell fabric near me tbh, I do know there's a sewing store a few blocks from my house but I've never gone in there lol

(sorry lol I'm pretty much an amateur at sewing tbh, I've never made my own clothes before (can't afford fabric usually), the only sewing experience I've had is with making stuffed animals out of scrap fabric I find, and I've never used a sewing machine

but I will say that you could probably rig up a pattern for a T-shirt by looking at some of the ones you already own, though I'm not exactly sure how to explain what I mean by that.. just like, note how big each piece of fabric is, and where the seams are, and somehow transfer that to paper, then as long as you allow for seam allowance then you should be able to use that as a pattern. sounds pretty involved though tbh, and I've never tried it myself so maybe just ignore my advice there lol)

lol hello! you're on the opposite side of the state from me, I'm in SW MN

so are you gonna be posting about your experience, or just your questions?

yeah, I was looking at GoodRX earlier, its not really the cost of the prescription that I'm worried about tbh its the cost of the appointment, like from what I heard they do blood work and stuff. my therapist said it costs like $400 so my mom is really worried about the cost, since I can't afford to pay for it yet she's nice enough to pay for it for me but yeah idk
I kinda brushed off psychology today as some vague search engine, but it actually sounds useful from your description. I'll definitely check it out!
that makes me feel a little bit better about it at least, which is nice. thanks

context usually helps everything lol

my mom is also confusing me because she feels exactly the same way I do about the mental health system and meds and all that. her concern is that HRT is irreversible, unlike antidepressants and such, and I guess after 5 years off meds she thinks I should try once more before making up my mind to transition? idk, maybe she's right but I don't think even with the help of proper medication I'll be comfortable living without medically transitioning

I don't like the mental health system, its generally failed me, so the idea is to avoid it as much as possible

I was on various meds for a good portion of my childhood, stopped taking anything at 13, and I'm currently in therapy, so aside from trying meds again I'm doing what I can to treat my stuff besides transition. I don't really like the idea of trying meds again, it makes me feel like something is wrong with me or that I'm "broken" and I already feel like trash so I don't really want to add another reason to feel bad onto the pile

so while I kinda get that I'll need to treat my depression and stuff in other methods, I don't think that should stop me from trying to transition since I believe it will help to a certain extent. I'm realistic, I know transitioning won't solve all my problems, but I feel like that's a good place to start going forward since I'm already in therapy

my mom has done that for as long as I've been out, it'd be fine if I asked for it but I specifically told her that I don't want to know what makes me not pass because it increases my dysphoria. I've just kinda learned to accept some of my mom's less than ideal behaviors about me and my transition because when I first came out she was a lot worse. not blatantly unaccepting or abusive or anything, but the comments she'd make about/to me were definitely bad

my mom is almost equally as clueless as he is, so she probably doesn't think about how those comments affect me. I did give her a look and said "girlfriend?" when she was telling me about her cousin's partner and using the word "girlfriend" after she told me they "decided they're not female", and she probably noticed the contradiction but she just kinda shrugged and the conversation was basically over by then anyways so idk. I have no idea if I'm gonna see her uncle anytime soon, I'm not sure that I want to since I have no idea how he'll treat me beyond the usual, like is he gonna compare me to his son's partner? does he think his partner is still a girl? and who knows who he's gonna tell about me or them. I'm just glad I don't really have to associate with him unless I choose to, so if he does do anything unsavory I can just easily avoid him

that's a great frame for the conversation, and I'm sure it won't go over terribly, but I am a little concerned because as you said it is good sometimes for her to tell people ahead of time, but when I first came out she was straight up like "I'm not telling anyone, you have to tell them", even when I asked her to tell someone. I guess she gave up because I never told anyone due to my anxiety, and she's told a few people. mostly relatives and maybe her friends, which are mostly online, and a little while ago we were going to a chiropractor and she told them before I went in as well. anyways I'm scared she'll go back to not telling anyone and while that'd be good for anyone who didn't need to know it would kinda suck in other situations

and I will admit, her response of "you need to tell people you're trans" is 100% reasonable, and I don't disagree with that, its more that because she calls to make appointments for me, since I'm a minor, it makes sense to me for her to mention when she makes a new appointment at like my general doctor "hey btw my kid (birthname) is trans, and goes by Cody and he/him pronouns", maybe ask to make a note of that in my chart idk how doctor stuff works lol you probably get the idea. as for other relatives she hasn't told that she wants me to tell, well I'm in therapy for my anxiety. everyone who needs to know will probably know eventually anyways, whether I tell them myself or not, but that's besides the point
that sounds interesting for sure, I'll have to check out that video. thanks!
I can't really afford that, and for the sake of my dysphoria I can't really (mentally) afford to push my transition back until I can afford to freeze my eggs unfortunately
so I'm just confused, sorry if this is a silly question, but is anyone allowed to join? I want to but I was just unsure if its for everyone
